arguments.message:
Sure! To see the breakdown of each line item on an invoice:

1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**.
2. Open the invoice you’re interested in.
3. Expand a line item – you’ll see its own breakdown (e.g., a seat charge will show how many seats were billed and the per‑seat rate, and an overage line will show the metered quantity beyond the plan’s limit).

The downloadable PDF contains the same breakdown, so you can attach it to an internal budget review without needing dashboard access.
